sources.entry: OctoEverywhere - OctoEverywhere is a 3D printing failure detection assistant that uses computer vision algorithms to detect printing errors such as spaghetti, layer shifts, adhesion issues, and more #paid

summary.name: OctoEverywhere
summary.one_liner: A cloud remote-access and AI print-failure-detection service for 3D printers running OctoPrint, Klipper, Bambu Lab OS, Elegoo OS and similar firmware.
use_cases: Monitor a 3D print remotely from a phone
Detect spaghetti or adhesion failures and pause a print automatically
Stream webcam video of a printer to a public link
Manage a small print farm from one dashboard
Receive push, Discord or Telegram alerts when prints finish or fail
summary.what_it_does: OctoEverywhere provides cloud remote access to 3D printer web interfaces such as OctoPrint, Klipper, Moonraker, Mainsail and Fluidd, using an end-to-end encrypted tunnel created by its plugin. Its Gadget AI feature detects common print failures like spaghetti, bed adhesion problems and layer issues, and can alert the user or pause the print. It includes full-frame-rate webcam streaming, public live streaming links, real-time notifications via push, Discord, Telegram and SMS, and a multi-printer dashboard with snapshots. Companion iPhone and Android apps (OctoApp, Mobileraker, OctoPod, Printer Tools, Polymer) are named on the page.
notable: Free tier includes unlimited remote access and unlimited AI failure detection for up to 3 printers
Optional Supporter subscription (listed at $3.99/mo on the pricing section and $2.49/mo in the FAQ) adds advanced AI models, advanced streaming and 5 printers
Printer is not publicly exposed; shared access uses revocable Shared Connection links
Claims to be funded by community supporter perks rather than ads or data sales
caveats: Free tier is limited to 3 printers; additional printers cost $1/printer/month on the Supporter plan
Advanced AI models, advanced webcam and live streaming, and larger uploads require the paid Supporter Perks
The page gives two different Supporter prices ($3.99/mo and $2.49/mo), so the current price is unclear
Obico comparison claims are the vendor's own marketing
